goal: Native Mi 9 (cepheus) emulator: custom QEMU machine, stock kernel+DTB+userspace, allowlisted stubs only.

milestones.title: Host toolchain ready
milestones.acceptance: scripts/doctor.sh reports every required tool with real versions and missing=0. Negative: run with an empty PATH, missing>0.

milestones.title: Firmware imported and hash-locked
milestones.acceptance: Importer copies the user's stock archive contents into firmware/extracted using real tools, prints real sha256 of archive and key images (boot, system, vendor, vbmeta, dtbo) and compares them to config/firmware.lock.json. Negative: tampered copy compares unequal.

milestones.title: Stock kernel Image and DTB extracted with real tools
milestones.acceptance: From the real boot.img: kernel Image and DTB(s) extracted with real tools into build/stock/. Evidence prints the stock kernel version string and the decompiled DTB compatible. Negative: same commands on an empty file yield neither.

milestones.title: QEMU machine `cepheus` skeleton
milestones.acceptance: Custom QEMU (pinned, overlay applied, built by scripts) starts machine `cepheus` paused (-S) with 8 CPUs and the SM8150 memory map taken from the stock DTB; monitor `info cpus` and `info mtree` show it. Negative: stock-style `-machine virt` run lacks the SM8150 regions.

milestones.title: Stock kernel boots with native GENI UART
milestones.acceptance: Stock Image + stock DTB boot on `cepheus`; kernel messages appear on the NATIVE GENI UART model via earlycon. Negative: UART model disabled -> no kernel output.

milestones.title: GICv3, arch timer, PSCI, 8-CPU SMP
milestones.acceptance: Kernel brings up 8 CPUs with native GICv3, arch timer and PSCI. Negative: boot with maxcpus=1 on the cmdline.

milestones.title: Native clock/reset, TLMM pinctrl, SPMI/PMIC models
milestones.acceptance: Native models for exactly what the stock kernel requests; each stock driver probe that previously deferred/failed now succeeds, shown by real kernel/debugfs output captured by a command-only probe. Failing probes are listed and classified (allowlisted vs missing model).

milestones.title: Native UFS host controller (+SMMU as needed)
milestones.acceptance: Stock kernel ufshcd-qcom probes the native UFS HC and enumerates LUNs as SCSI disks. Negative: UFS model removed -> no SCSI disk lines.

milestones.title: Real GPT/LUNs from real images
milestones.acceptance: LUN images built from the real stock images; the stock kernel parses the real GPT and exposes real partitions (/proc/partitions printed raw by a command-only probe). Negative: corrupted GPT -> no partitions.

milestones.title: Real Android init (first and second stage)
milestones.acceptance: Stock ramdisk -> real Android init prints its own first/second stage logs on the kernel log. Negative: ramdisk removed.

milestones.title: Dynamic partitions mounted by real init
milestones.acceptance: Real init mounts system/vendor/product from the real super (dm-linear) with the ROM's fstab.

milestones.title: SELinux enforcing with the ROM policy
milestones.acceptance: ROM policy loaded by real init, enforcing, no global permissive, denials visible.

milestones.title: Real property service, binder and service managers
milestones.acceptance: Real servicemanager/hwservicemanager/vndservicemanager running over real binder; service list printed raw by the real tool.

milestones.title: Allowlisted stubs registered; system_server starts
milestones.acceptance: TZ/modem/DSP/GPU/camera/sensors handled only by registered stubs; framework (zygote, system_server) starts.

milestones.title: sys.boot_completed from the real init
milestones.acceptance: Property set by the real boot flow, read by real getprop; never set by hand.

milestones.title: Stock adbd over virtual transport
milestones.acceptance: Real adb to the guest; real pm list packages / getprop output from the real guest.

milestones.title: MIUI system apps launch
milestones.acceptance: Defined set of system apps launches via real am/pm; scripted checks on real state.

milestones.title: Debug, snapshot, performance
milestones.acceptance: GDB stub, VM snapshots, benchmark baseline on the i5-2400 host profile.
